text:
andrew: quick note - after yesterday's kernel selector change we saw host p99 for short-chat jump ~20%. flamegraph shows tokenization + proto parse + many tiny gRPC writes dominating host CPU.

sophie: can you paste the top functions?

andrew: summary from 4m perf: host_tokenize_fastpath 30%, proto::ParseReflection 24%, utf8_normalize 10%, grpc::writev 9%, kvcache::evict 5%, selector 3%, other 19%. many responses are 1-2 small write calls (avg 220 bytes).

mike: sounds like kernel change improved long-seq batching but shifted work to host for short requests. two mitigations: short-seq kernel fallback and reduce host work.

lee: also saw brief kv eviction spikes tied to new route tag. may need to pin hot prefixes or increase headroom.

andrew: proposed actions:
- coalescer: implement small write coalescer (timer 1-2ms or 1KB) behind flag (owner: lee)
- tokenizer: ascii-only fast-path with stack buffer for <=64B, small LRU pretoken cache per route (owner: sophie)
- proto: generate inline decoders for top shapes (owner: mike)
- kernel: selector fallback for seq_len < 40 to use short-seq kernel (owner: mike)
- kv: temporary 15% cache bump during canary and pin hot prefixes (ops)
- metrics: add host.parse_cpu_by_route, smallwrite_ratio_by_route

sophie: canary coalescer only first? lowest risk.

andrew: yes. will open canary PR with feature flags and telemetry.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled: infra v2.20.1 -> canary (flags: coalescer=true, kv-bump=true) :rocket:

~canary results~
andrew: initial canary: p99 host down ~12% with coalescer + kv bump. smallwrite ratio dropped 70%->30%. token parse still high.
sophie: enabling ascii-fastpath next.
mike: inline proto patch ready for bench; will gate behind flag.

lee: note coalescer adds up to ~0.7ms tail in worst-case local sim; adaptive timer advisable.
andrew: agreed. next steps: run ascii-fastpath in canary, merge inline proto decoders, add kernel fallback. will update perf artifacts here.

andrew: tagging @sophie @mike @lee — leaving follow-ups in PRs.
